environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on EC2 behind an AWS ALB with default configuration. ALB performs basic health checks and round-robin load balancing. No request header filtering or validation is configured. Traffic flows directly from ALB to the Express application on port 3000. The application uses node-cache for in-process response caching with a 5-minute TTL.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with default listener rules
config.network: VPC with public subnet, security group allows inbound 443
